specification_author: Prepare an OpenSpec proposal, design, delta specifications and tasks for the accepted issue. Preserve the original implementation acceptance and add observable regression criteria for a defect.
protected_tests: Write isolated acceptance tests for the approved requirements. Check the reported behavior, keep the test files private, and report the covered classes for the baseline runner.
implementation: Implement the approved requirements within the selected writable scope. Use the public test coverage and any retained rework feedback; add and run visible regression tests. Report evidence or a requirements defect without inventing test results.
review: Independently review the exact candidate against the approved requirements. Report concrete findings and a verdict with evidence. Keep the candidate unchanged.
validation_classification: Classify the retained validation failure using the trusted report. Distinguish a candidate defect, an environment or harness problem, and missing evidence. Do not infer success when the checks did not complete.
